description.value: Momo Tanghulu is a dessert and juice cafe in Richmond specializing in tanghulu, the traditional Chinese candied-fruit skewer treat. Located in a commercial unit on Buswell Street, it offers a sweet pit stop for cyclists passing through Richmond's urban core. The shop's evening-friendly hours make it a viable post-ride destination.
